text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bonjour! Comment allez-vous!
Let the blood-soaked game of "Who's the Werewolf?" begin!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh, interesting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's "Who Is the Werewolf? Game" was about to begin.
The participants were Gold Ship, Nakayama Festa,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sirius Symboli, El Condor Pasa,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe, Satono Diamond,
and myself, who somehow got dragged into this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple! Find the 'werewolf' hiding
among us through discussion!
No fistfights, alright?! You know the drill, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The roles are: 2 Werewolves, 1 Possessed,
1 Seer, 1 Medium, and 2 Villagers.
My role is 'Villager.'

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Then without further ado, game start!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Since there aren't many of us,
I'll go ahead and claim Fortune Teller right now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ha, bluffing right out of the gate, Sirius?
I'm coming out as the Fortune Teller too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, picking a fight with me so casually.
I'll make you regret it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, is one of them the Werewolf... or more likely the Lunatic? Then again, both of them act like lunatics on a regular basis, so I can't tell at all!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: Look who's talking!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, that El who's usually so loud
is awfully quiet, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...The werewolf usually tends to grow quiet.
I believe we should vote for El-san...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Que!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"The start of Day 2...
Oh woe is me, the tragic heroine Golshi-chan, bitten by a wolf, shall watch over you all from heaven!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Fortune result:
Manhattan Cafe is the 'Werewolf.'"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Fortune result:
Satono Diamond is the 'Werewolf.'"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... if that's the case,
from my point of view, Nakayama-san is definitely the fake "Seer."
Which makes Cafe-san the "Werewolf."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I think... the opposite.
...Satono-san is the 'Werewolf.'"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, we'll just be talking in circles at this rate.
Though that's the best part of this game.
...Hehe, now I'm getting fired up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If things continue along this path,
Sirius Symboli and Satono Diamond will vote for Manhattan Cafe, and"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and Manhattan Cafe
will probably vote for Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe and Satono Diamond.
The game will be decided by who I vote for!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please remember.
Who was the very first person to suspect El just now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. And it seems her deduction was correct.
Which means... the Werewolf is...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"And now, the results announcement—!
The winner is... the Werewolf team!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli was the one who saw through El Condor Pasa as the Werewolf.
Doesn't that mean Sirius Symboli must be the true Seer!?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, sorry for making you trust me, Trainer.
It was a betrayal from within.
As the 'Madman', I sold out El, the 'Werewolf'.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
By deliberately 'finding' the Werewolf,
I looked way more like the real 'Seer,' right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, the Madman took down the Werewolf, huh?
Nice, totally throwing standard theory out the window.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, my Fortune Teller bluff carried even more weight. We won in the end, so no harm done, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sirius-senpaaaai! Thank you so muuuuch!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...But I got lynched on Day 1, desu.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haha, that was some good bait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, we won!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was completely fooled.
I spent a truly fulfilling time together with them,
impressed by how remarkably clever they all were.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"And now, the results announcement—!
The winner is... the Villager team!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Good grief, it didn't go that smoothly, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's true that Sirius Symboli was the first
to suspect El Condor Pasa.
However, she was likely just cutting ties with her own circle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether she was the Madman or a Werewolf, intentionally 'discovering' a Werewolf
served to make her fake claim as the Seer much more convincing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It occurred to me that making such a tricky wager would be just like Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Trainer.
Your judgment... wasn't bad at all...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Impressive you didn't let Sirius fool you.
Not half bad, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yay! A huge victory for Golshi-chan!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Golshi-chan didn't do anything!
You guys... no, Satono!
Don't kill the Medium on Night 1!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I managed to secure a victory by a hair's breadth.
Throwing myself into such a thrilling game made for a truly fulfilling time.
